name: Tachibana Nonoka
source:
Favorite food: Shortcake

A bright, energetic, and hard working girl. She's good at focusing at one thing, especially when making a confectionery. Loves shoujo manga and is longing for sweet romances. 

She is the girl from cake shop where protagonist bought his first chocolate cake. Her dream is to make a cake that will make everyone smile.
